title: Acting Arena: Motion Inventory and Performance Challenges
status: Designed benchmark and inventory schema; no clips imported, catalog enumeration performed, or tests executed.
purpose: Index motions by what they can contribute to a performance, then test contact, transitions, intention and stylization in situated challenges.

sources.supports: Library browsing, search, preview and animation controls.
Performance criteria including timing, staging, anticipation, follow-through and secondary action.

rig_families.adapter: Retarget source joints; calibrate rest pose, proportions, axes and scale.
Retarget plus contact correction and authored stylization.
Translate intent, trajectory, effort and contact events into an independently authored eight-legged gait and gesture system; no claim of direct humanoid retargeting.
Separate morphology-specific locomotion and performance adapter required.

review.reporting: Record technical pass/fail separately from qualitative performance notes; preserve failed takes. Numeric tolerances must be calibrated to asset scale and frame rate.

reference_benchmarks.feature_animation: Manually annotated short reference scenes; record source title, edition, timecodes, action beats and principle tested. No claim of complete Disney coverage.
reference_benchmarks.sports_games: Manually annotated game clips with event timing and input-response behavior; record title, version, character, platform and timecodes. No claim of complete Backyard Sports coverage.

challenges.title: Walk without spilling
challenges.situation: Carry a brim-full cup through a turn, stop, then resume.
challenges.success_observation: The cup stays upright; planted feet do not slide; stopping has weight.

challenges.title: Sprint and reconsider
challenges.situation: Sprint toward a destination, recognize someone, brake and return casually.
challenges.success_observation: Braking precedes reversal; momentum and change of intention remain readable.

challenges.title: Crouch under trouble
challenges.situation: Walk, crouch under a low beam, look back, stand only after clearing it.
challenges.success_observation: Head and body clear beam; gaze does not break locomotion.

challenges.title: Spin and find the target
challenges.situation: Turn rapidly through a full rotation then settle facing a moving partner.
challenges.success_observation: Feet and root agree; turn ends without teleporting; gaze reacquires target.

challenges.title: Jump into water
challenges.situation: Approach an edge, hesitate, take off, enter water, surface and orient.
challenges.success_observation: Takeoff contact, entry event, buoyancy transition and recovery are distinct.

challenges.title: Overshoot the ledge
challenges.situation: Run, jump too far, catch an edge, hang and pull up.
challenges.success_observation: Hands attach at the ledge; body weight hangs below grip; recovery is continuous.

challenges.title: Slip and recover
challenges.situation: Step onto a slick patch, slip, windmill arms and regain balance.
challenges.success_observation: Support changes plausibly; recovery responds to the actual slip direction.

challenges.title: Stand after a fall
challenges.situation: Fall sideways, pause, assess pain, get up and continue.
challenges.success_observation: Ground contacts remain coherent; injury affects the next action.

challenges.title: Door opens the wrong way
challenges.situation: Arrive confidently, push a pull door, notice, reposition and open it.
challenges.success_observation: Hand tracks the handle; door hinge and body clearances remain valid.

challenges.title: The unexpectedly heavy box
challenges.situation: Reach for a box, fail to lift, regrip and lift with effort.
challenges.success_observation: Hands stay on box; load changes preparation and whole-body effort.

challenges.title: Chair moved away
challenges.situation: Begin sitting, detect the absent chair and recover before falling.
challenges.success_observation: Seat expectation, surprise and recovery have distinct timing.

challenges.title: Hand over reluctantly
challenges.situation: Offer an object, hesitate at release, then let the other person take it.
challenges.success_observation: Ownership switches once at release; no duplicated or floating prop.

challenges.title: Punch that misses
challenges.situation: Wind up, punch at a moving target, miss and recover guard.
challenges.success_observation: Reach follows target geometry; miss produces follow-through; no automatic hit.

challenges.title: Kick and keep balance
challenges.situation: Kick a target, encounter resistance, retract and regain stance.
challenges.success_observation: Support foot and hip rotation agree; impact response differs from miss.

challenges.title: Block into retreat
challenges.situation: Block a strike, lose ground, duck the next strike and disengage.
challenges.success_observation: Both performers share event timing; retreat remains spatially possible.

challenges.title: Fight becomes apology
challenges.situation: Prepare to strike, recognize a friend, abort and offer help.
challenges.success_observation: Attack aborts before contact; intention changes without a pose snap.

challenges.title: Dance through a missed beat
challenges.situation: Dance, miss a beat, glance at partner and rejoin rhythm.
challenges.success_observation: Beat phase changes visibly; recovery rejoins partner rather than restarting.

challenges.title: Spin with a partner
challenges.situation: Take hands, turn together, exchange places and release.
challenges.success_observation: Shared grip stays attached; pivots avoid intersection; release is synchronized.

challenges.title: Celebration interrupted
challenges.situation: Celebrate a point, discover it was disallowed, compose yourself.
challenges.success_observation: Celebration does not instantly vanish; social recovery is legible.

challenges.title: Too big for the stage
challenges.situation: Perform a broad dance in a cramped area, adjust without losing rhythm.
challenges.success_observation: Reach adapts to real boundaries while phrase timing persists.

challenges.title: Cower then help
challenges.situation: Hide from danger, notice another person exposed, emerge to help.
challenges.success_observation: Attention redirects before body commits; fear remains in helpful action.

challenges.title: Pretend the box is light
challenges.situation: Carry a heavy box while trying to look effortless in front of someone.
challenges.success_observation: Effort leaks through support and recovery despite composed presentation.

challenges.title: The false confident entrance
challenges.situation: Enter proudly, discover the wrong room, retreat without attracting notice.
challenges.success_observation: Discovery precedes redirection; retreat preserves character intention.

challenges.title: Wait without becoming inert
challenges.situation: Wait for an answer, prepare to leave, hear a reply and turn back.
challenges.success_observation: Stillness retains attention; a small cue causes an observable response.

challenges.title: Baseball grounder
challenges.situation: Track a bouncing ball, crouch, field it, transfer and throw.
challenges.success_observation: Hand and ball meet at the same time and position; ownership transfers once.

challenges.title: Basketball fake
challenges.situation: Dribble, fake a pass, pivot and shoot while a defender reacts.
challenges.success_observation: Ball contacts follow hand timing; pivot foot stays planted; defender reads cue.

challenges.title: Soccer whiff
challenges.situation: Chase a ball, swing a kick, miss, stumble and keep playing.
challenges.success_observation: Miss stays a miss; ball trajectory is independent; recovery keeps play alive.

challenges.title: Tennis late return
challenges.situation: Split-step, chase wide, reach late, return and recover center.
challenges.success_observation: Racket meets ball or visibly misses; footwork reaches actual ball position.

challenges.title: Carry a table through a door
challenges.situation: Two characters carry a table, rotate through a threshold and set it down.
challenges.success_observation: Shared object stays rigid; grips persist; both bodies clear threshold.

challenges.title: Crowded doorway
challenges.situation: One character holds a door while others enter and someone tries to close it.
challenges.success_observation: Conflicting intentions produce a visible negotiation and valid contacts.

challenges.title: Catch a falling friend
challenges.situation: Notice a partner slipping, reach, catch their weight and stabilize together.
challenges.success_observation: Reaction has latency; contact carries weight; combined support is credible.

challenges.title: Chain reaction
challenges.situation: A dancer bumps a carrier, a cup tips, a third character catches it and the dancer apologizes.
challenges.success_observation: Events cause one another; prop states persist; reactions remain individually readable.
